_comment: Delta Rentals Dubai (TRIPLE D RENTALS L.L.C.). Generated by scripts/import_delta_fleet.py from their WordPress REST API and vehicle pages. THIS REMAINS A DEMONSTRATION CONFIGURATION until every entry in _assumed is confirmed by the operator — real prices under a real company name make a wrong answer more damaging, not less.

_assumed._comment: Not published by Delta. Confirm each before go-live.
_assumed.colour_and_interior: Never published per vehicle. All 'unspecified', so a customer asking for a black one gets a check rather than a claim.
_assumed.year: Not published. Null, so the customer is told 'Mercedes-Benz G63' rather than a model year nobody stated.
_assumed.category_seats_luggage: Classified from the model name against manufacturer specification, not Delta's data. Worth a glance.
_assumed.deposit: Listings say no deposit; the terms say AED 5,000-20,000 varying by vehicle, driver and duration. Encoded as 0 to match the listings.
_assumed.extra_km_price: AED 25-150/km by vehicle in the terms. Left at 0 rather than guessed.
_assumed.weekly_and_monthly: Listed as 'on request'. Null, so the engine bills daily x days.
_assumed.availability: Delta publishes none. A handful of seeded blocks are added so the alternatives flow is demonstrable; everything else reads as free.
_assumed.features: No feature lists are published. Empty rather than invented.
